name: Saplings, trees and leaf decay
note: Leaves take their distance from logs through block ticks after updates, as both official servers do, and decay at distance 7 unless persistent in random ticks with their loot, as the official 1.21.8 server does
deviations: saplings do not grow into trees
scaffolding's distance is not seen by leaves
1.21.4's decay is not compared (its random ticks run only near players, and the harness has none)
